items.name: Schiller Theater FMC Utrecht 2024
items.information:
**English**

Do you need to practice for [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024)? Do you want to qualify for [Euros](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2024#34620-qualification)? Are you just crazy about Fewest Moves? Then this is the competition for you! Come to the Schiller Theatre and unlock harmonious solutions, echoing the spirit of Mozart's brilliance that once graced its hall.

Make sure to read and understand the [venue rules](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SchillerTheaterFMCUtrecht2024#42046-venue-rules-huisregels) before the competition.

Wil jij oefenen voor [FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024)? Zorg dat je de [huis regels](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SchillerTheaterFMCUtrecht2024#42046-venue-rules-huisregels) gelezen en begrepen hebt voor de competitie.

items.information:
Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju.

---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

venue.address: Stepping Stones Rd, Durbanville, Cape Town, 7550

items.information:
CubingZA is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2024, and the first to be held in the Northern Suburbs! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, with multiple rounds of 3x3, 2x2, and Pyraminx, as well as one round of 4x4 and Skewb. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

**SPECTATORS**
Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them.

**VOLUNTEERING**
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

**About CubingZA**
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please get in touch by contacting us [here](https://cubingza.org/contact).

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png)
### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM.

items.name: Gem City Airplane Mode Special 2024

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Addess will be emailed once registration closes

items.information:
This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio.

As space in the venue is limited, you may bring a maximum of one guest.

items.name: Burley Summer 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the Registration and Waistlist Info tab.

Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

items.name: Blind Faith Denver 2024
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events. We do not recommend this competition for newer competitors, but all are welcome. 

### If you are interested in normal speedsolving events, please look into other competitions in this area, and stay tuned for future announcements

FMC is the main event of the competition. 

### *By signing up, you agree to contribute throughout the entirety of the competition due to the small size*.

items.name: Amherst FMC Challenge 2024

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors.

items.information: The only event at this competition will be 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.

items.name: Alabama Championship 2024
items.information:
### Thank you for attending Alabama Championship 2024! Check out the [Alabama Champions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlabamaChampionship2024#44420-alabama-champions) tab to view the state podiums for this competition!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnBnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7a09718d6054d5a655cef0d7fc5baea3b0c67969/al-champs-png.png)

Welcome to Alabama Championship 2024, the first championship in state history!

The competition is open to all, but only Alabama residents are eligible for state champion titles. See [AL Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlabamaChampionship2024#36807-al-champion-eligibility) for more info.

**You must read ALL registration requirements BEFORE registering!**

This competition is supported and [recognized](https://cubingusa.org/state_championships) by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).
